whenToUse: Letting visitors or users switch between light and dark (and optionally system) themes on a site or app.
Driving SiteShell's theme prop or a ThemeScope from a reader-controlled switch (target={null} with onValueChange).
avoidWhen: A section or block that should always be dark — set the theme on Section, ThemeScope or SiteShell instead.
Generic on/off settings — use switch or toggle.
a11y: With two modes it is one toggle button named "Dark mode" with aria-pressed; with three it names the current mode ("Theme: System"); the segmented variant is a labelled radio group.
Icon-only buttons get an accessible name and a title; with showLabel the visible text starts the accessible name.
Use modeToggleScript in the document head so a stored dark choice never flashes light on reload.
